product.schneider-d486sx25.summary: The 486SX desktop positioned between the 386DX and 486DX.
product.schneider-d486sx25.history: The December 1992 German price list offered this machine for DM 1,797 net without a hard disk. It included MS-DOS 5.0 and Windows 3.1.
product.schneider-d486sx25.technical.opt: The list also offered a 106 MB hard-disk configuration for DM 2,280 net.
product.schneider-d486sx25.technical.slo: The slots accommodate expansion cards. The sales sheet lists 7 16-bit slots and two floppy drives, 1.44 MB and 1.2 MB.
product.schneider-d486sx25.technical.ver: The offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
product.schneider-d486sx25.technical.lim: The board still needs identification, an attributed BIOS needs preservation and an image with clear publication rights remains pending.
product.schneider-d486sx25.technical.pri: CC SELLER / BC, Schneider Computer, 12/1992, pp. 1–3
